samples.question: The image contains exactly one solid dark region; every light-grey blob is background clutter. Take the dark region's own centre of mass as the reference point and test three motions about it: mirror-left-right (reflection across the vertical line through that point), mirror-top-bottom (reflection across the horizontal line through that point), and half-turn (rotation by 180 degrees about that point). Answer ambiguous if two or more motions map the region onto itself. Which motion maps the dark region onto itself: mirror-left-right, mirror-top-bottom, half-turn, or ambiguous?
